verdict.rationale: Greptile documents an official MCP server (MCP v2). It covers OAuth setup for Cursor, Claude Code, VS Code and Codex, and exposes tools to fetch unaddressed PR comments, read the repo knowledge base, and view, search and create coding patterns. Auto-fix workflows such as /check-pr and /greploop run through the same server, and a probe confirmed the docs page exists. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on community corroboration of the MCP server in real use.
